answer: 可能可以。如果因为生病或其他特殊情况无法在指定日期参加考试，可以申请延期，但必须提供证明文件，并且要在截止时间前申请。

points.text: 生病属于可申请延期的特殊情况之一，但考试必须是因为无法控制的特殊情况而无法在指定日期完成。
points.quote: You may be eligible to defer your scheduled final assessment (exam) if you couldn’t complete it on the set date due to exceptional circumstances beyond your control.
points.title: Defer or reschedule your scheduled final assessment (exam)

points.text: 因病缺考时，需要立即从医生或校园健康服务中心获取医疗证明（或认可的替代证明）。
points.quote: you need to immediately get a medical certificate (or an approved alternative) from your doctor or a campus health service to be considered eligible to defer your assessment.
points.title: Defer or reschedule your scheduled final assessment (exam)

points.text: 申请截止时间是考试指定日期当天晚上11:55；逾期申请只有在能提供证明，说明特殊情况使你无法按时申请时才会被接受。
points.quote: We won’t accept an application for a deferred or rescheduled assessment after the deadline (11.55pm on its set date) unless you can show with supporting documents that exceptional circumstances beyond your control prevented you from applying on time
points.title: Defer or reschedule your scheduled final assessment (exam)

points.text: 成绩公布后，将不再接受延期或重新安排考试的申请。
points.quote: Once results are released, we won’t accept any applications to defer or reschedule assessments.
points.title: Defer or reschedule your scheduled final assessment (exam)
